statement: A monster whose text only says "Cannot be Normal Summoned or Set" can be Special Summoned by a card effect.
question: Can a rule also Special Summon it (a Pendulum Summon), or only a card effect?
meanwhile: RML says only what its text does: it cannot be Normal Summoned, and it has no Summon condition.

sources.name: Rare Metal Dragon
sources.says: "Cannot be Normal Summoned" isn't treated as an effect. Rare Metal Dragon is a Special Summon Monster: Special Summoned by a card effect, it can be Summoned from places other than the hand too. It doesn't say whether a Summon that isn't a card effect's can Summon it.

scripts: Rare Metal Dragon's script lets it be Special Summoned only by an effect (SPSUMMON_CONDITION).
